title: SG Enable's Support for ITE Graduates with Disabilities to Access Host Companies under Work-Study Diploma Programme
what_it_is: SG Enable's Support for ITE Graduates with Disabilities to Access Host Companies under Work-Study Diploma Programme

sections.label: SG Enable support for ITE trainees
sections.summary: SG Enable provides job coaches, employer advice, inclusive employer connections and disability awareness training, while ITE works with employers on support arrangements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: ITE graduates with disabilities participating in the Work-Study Diploma Programme may approach SG Enable for employment support from trained job coaches.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: They provide job support services, such as fostering workplace integration, and they also provide employers with practical advice on job redesign.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: SG Enable also connects interested inclusive employers with ITE to participate in the Work-Study Diploma Programme and offers disability awareness training to these employers to better support and integrate employees with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Eric Chua) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In addition to support from SG Enable, ITE also works with employers to ensure that necessary support arrangements are in place for trainees with disabilities.

sections.label: Repository and deadline flexibility proposals
sections.summary: The Member asks if the Ministry would consider a centralised repository of inclusive employers and flexible programme deadlines for persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
sentences.text: Could I ask if the Ministry would also consider establishing and regularly updating a centralised repository of inclusive employers, for example, the companies recognised under the SG Enable Enabling Mark, to make this available to schools offering the Work-Study Diploma programme, especially, not just for the diploma but also for work attachments, industrial attachments?

sentences.speaker: Ms Yeo Wan Ling (Punggol)
sentences.text: The other one too: would the Ministry also consider working with the schools and SG Enable to provide flexibility, especially with the extension of programme deadlines for our persons with disabilities, especially if they are unable to find a suitable host organisation within the stipulated deadline or timeframes, for reasons unrelated to their academic merits?

sections.label: Ministry response on time extensions
sections.summary: The Ministry says it could take the time extension suggestion back and explore it, and that each student's possibilities need to be explored.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: As to time extensions, I think we could take the suggestion back and explore her suggestion.

sentences.speaker: Mr Eric Chua
sentences.text: But even if we were to grant time extension, I think it goes back to the first point that I mentioned earlier, and that is for each student, we need to really explore what the possibilities are.
